scope: All 2763 registered stock pages, including shared preferred-stock references, and all 23179 financial rows loaded by the production loader. Automated amount/period/unit/source checks with targeted original-table inspection; not a claim of a fresh manual reread of every filing or company narrative.

sourceCoverage.limitation: Official DART connections began ending prematurely (ECONNRESET/ResponseEnded). Fresh response collection was stopped after repeated failures; previously retained official source files were used only with matching issuer/basis/currency/actual period and receipt freshness. Unconfirmed items are not treated as valid or silently changed.
